content: संनिधानम्, संनिधिः .²1 Putting down together, juxtaposition. .²2 Proximity, vicinity, presence; असत्यामाकाङ्क्षायां संनिधानमकारणम् <ls>ŚB. on MS. 6. 4. 23</ls>; <ls>N. 2. 53</ls>. .²3 Perceptibility, appearance. .²4 A receptacle. .²5 Receiving, taking charge of. .²6 Combination, aggregate; दोषाणां संनिधानम् (स्त्रीयन्त्रम्) <ls>Pt. 1. 191</ls>. .²7 Depositing. .²8 The object of an organ of sense (इन्द्रियविषय).
